item.title: Rust for .NET developers [Spanish]
item.description: In this session, we will explore how .NET developers can transition into the Rust ecosystem. We’ll examine the core differences and similarities between C# and the Microsoft stack. By contrasting familiar .NET patterns with Rust-specific concepts—such as ownership, the borrow checker, and memory safety.
